units.source_text: 源氏公子见她直率道出心事，不禁悲从中来。

en.t: When Prince Genji saw her speak her heart so frankly, sorrow welled up in him despite himself.

units.source_text: 虽然竭力忍耐，终于泪如泉涌。

en.t: Though he tried with all his might to hold back, at last his tears poured out like a spring.

units.source_text: 不悉详情的人猜想：“虽然是穷乡僻壤，二三年来住惯了，一旦匆匆离去，当然不免悲伤。”

en.t: Those who did not know the details supposed, Even though this is a remote and humble place, after living here for two or three years one naturally feels sorrow when suddenly forced to leave.

units.source_text: 只有良清心中不快，想道：“一定是同那女的打得火热了。”

en.t: Only Yoshikiyo felt displeased in his heart and thought, He must have become deeply involved with that woman.

units.source_text: 随从者大家欢喜雀跃，但想起今天为限，即将离去这明石浦，又不免口口声声地伤离惜别。

en.t: All the attendants rejoiced and leapt with happiness, but when they remembered that today was their last day and that they would soon leave this Akashi shore, they too could not help speaking again and again of the sorrow of parting.

units.source_text: 然而这些也毋庸细说了。

en.t: But there is no need to go into these matters in detail.
